purpose: Teach: 倉敷/ストライク/ワルツ/アイアン/鉄筋/蝋/シンデレラ/タンゴ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと倉敷の街並みを歩いたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I walked through the streets of Kurashiki with your father.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Gentle opening, unhurried pace. Voice trails slightly at the end, as if watching the scene unfold again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、野球を観てストライクで応援されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and your grandfather loved going to the baseball games, didn't he? How he'd cheer at every strike.
lines.style: Warm recollection, nodding along with her own memories. Gentle rhythm, voice lilts slightly upward at the end. Affectionate, including him in the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんとワルツを踊ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father and I danced the waltz together.
lines.style: Voice softer still, almost to himself. Slight catch of nostalgia at the memory. Measured, deliberate pacing — savoring each word.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ゴルフのアイアンを大事になさってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather took such care of his golf irons, didn't he, dear? He was so particular about them.
lines.style: Gently indulgent, as if correcting him without correcting him. Warm smile in her voice. Patient, almost lilting at the details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが鉄筋の家を建てられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father built us a solid house with his own hands.
lines.style: Pride underneath the wistfulness. Firmer on 'built.' Voice settles into quiet certainty, then fades back into memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お仏壇に蝋燭を毎日灯されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather lit the candles at the altar every single day, didn't he, dear? Such devotion.
lines.style: Reverent, slightly breathless. Voice slows on 'every day,' honoring the ritual. Tender but firm—she is bearing witness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお孫様にシンデレラのお話をされた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father would tell the grandchildren the story of Cinderella.
lines.style: Warm, almost fatherly inflection now. Voice lifts slightly on 'Cinderella'—he can hear the children's wonder. Gentle, present tense rising.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、タンゴの音楽を楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather loved the tango music when he was young, didn't he, dear? He'd listen for hours.
lines.style: Knowing, affectionate close. Voice softens at the end, fading into shared quiet. She reaches back to meet him in the memory.
